description: Royal and destructive degrees as commonly listed in Russian-language astrology. Degree numbers are 1-based within each sign. Signs without an entry have no listed degree.
sources_note: Both sources give identical numbers; neither names an original author. Attribution to a specific school is not confirmed.
convention_note: Sources do not state whether 'the 13th degree' means 12°00'–12°59' (ordinal, default) or 13°00'–13°59' (exact). Use --degree-convention to choose.
